settings.customCharacterStyle: Exact canonical brothers from CHARACTER_SHEETS. Never alter faces, skin, hair, outfits, props, age or height relationship.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous racing scenes. Same vehicle, lane, checkpoint, damage and fuel state persist. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One speaker maximum.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP06 — แข่งรถสุดป่วน
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเข้าสู่ Racing World เลือกรถคันเดียว ฝึกบังคับ ผ่านเช็กพอยต์ หลบสิ่งกีดขวาง ซ่อมล้อที่หลุดจากร่อง และขับเข้าเส้นชัยด้วยกัน
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous race adventure. Exact brother identities remain fixed. The same kart persists throughout; position, wheel state, checkpoints and route cannot reset.

scenes.title: สนามแข่ง
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers arrive beside one small two-seat blocky kart at race lobby.
scenes.mainAction: older brother checks kart while younger circles to passenger side

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ใช้คันนี้กัน

scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers, one plain two-seat kart, no logos or text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Character Sheets primary. Medium reveal of same kart. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older brother stands by driver seat, younger by passenger seat; kart stationary facing track start.

scenes.title: ขึ้นรถ
scenes.continuityStartState: Older at driver side, younger at passenger side, same stationary kart.
scenes.mainAction: both sit in their fixed seats

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ผมพร้อมแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene + Character Sheets. Older driver-left, younger passenger-right, same kart.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side shot of boarding. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both seated and buckled; kart still at start; first green light ahead without readable text.

scenes.title: ออกตัว
scenes.continuityStartState: Both seated in same seats at start line.
scenes.imageDescription: Same kart begins moving from start; older driving, younger passenger, no extra racers blocking them.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low rear tracking. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Kart passes first bend entrance; both remain seated; checkpoint arch visible ahead.

scenes.title: เช็กพอยต์แรก
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart entering first bend; checkpoint arch ahead.
scenes.mainAction: older brother steers through bend and checkpoint

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เลี้ยวซ้าย

scenes.imageDescription: Same kart and lane, older steering left, younger pointing. Checkpoint remains behind after crossing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Three-quarter follow through one bend. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Kart exits checkpoint onto straight; checkpoint behind completed; moving barriers visible ahead.

scenes.title: สิ่งกีดขวาง
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart on straight, checkpoint behind, barriers cycling ahead.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother watches timing and signals open gap

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ช่องขวาเปิดแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same kart approaching cycling barriers; younger points right, older keeps wheel steady.
scenes.videoPrompt: Front side angle, barriers visible. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Right gap open; kart aligned right; older begins steering toward gap.

scenes.title: ลอดช่อง
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart aligned with open right gap.
scenes.imageDescription: Same barrier state at start, same kart passes once; barriers remain behind afterward.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low side tracking through gap. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Kart clears barrier section; downhill ramp starts ahead; speed slightly increased.

scenes.title: ลงทางลาด
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart at top of downhill ramp with increased speed.
scenes.mainAction: older brother keeps kart centered while descending

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: จับไว้แน่นๆ

scenes.imageDescription: Same kart and riders descending one ramp; no jump cut or vehicle change.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow down ramp. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Kart reaches bottom; front-right wheel drops into shallow groove and kart stops safely.

scenes.title: ล้อติดร่อง
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart stationary at bottom; front-right wheel stuck in shallow groove.
scenes.mainAction: both inspect stuck wheel from their seats

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ล้อติดแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same kart stopped, exact front-right wheel visibly in groove; both still seated.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low wheel reveal then tilt to brothers. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both have climbed out; older beside wheel, younger at kart side; kart remains stuck in exact groove.

scenes.title: ช่วยกันยก
scenes.continuityStartState: Both outside kart; front-right wheel stuck; older beside wheel, younger opposite side.
scenes.mainAction: they lift and push kart just enough to free wheel

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: หนึ่ง สอง ดัน

scenes.imageDescription: Same stuck kart; both push together; wheel rises from groove once.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium teamwork shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Kart free and stationary on track; wheel intact; both stand beside their original seats.

scenes.title: ขึ้นรถอีกครั้ง
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart free and stationary; both beside fixed seats.

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ไปต่อได้แล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same kart, wheel now free, older driver-left and younger passenger-right.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side boarding shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both seated; kart begins moving; spiral turn visible ahead.

scenes.title: โค้งเกลียว
scenes.mainAction: older brother steers through one smooth spiral

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ตามโค้งไว้

scenes.imageDescription: Same kart entering and following one spiral track, no lane reset.
scenes.videoPrompt: Banked tracking shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Kart exits spiral; final checkpoint and finish ramp visible ahead.

scenes.title: เช็กพอยต์สุดท้าย
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart exits spiral onto final straight; checkpoint ahead.

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เหลือเส้นชัย

scenes.imageDescription: Same kart crosses final checkpoint; completed checkpoint stays behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Front three-quarter follow. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Finish ramp directly ahead; kart centered and moving at moderate speed.

scenes.title: ทางลาดสุดท้าย
scenes.mainAction: older brother drives up ramp without leaving track
scenes.imageDescription: Same kart climbs one finish ramp; brothers remain seated.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low rear follow up ramp. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Kart crests ramp; finish platform and parking zone visible ahead.

scenes.title: เข้าเส้นชัย
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart cresting ramp toward finish platform.
scenes.mainAction: kart rolls across finish line and slows
scenes.imageDescription: Same kart enters finish platform; no text banners required; slowdown visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking deceleration. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Kart stopped in parking zone; both still seated; return portal visible beside platform.

scenes.title: ลงจากรถ
scenes.continuityStartState: Kart parked; return portal beside platform.
scenes.mainAction: both exit same seats and stand beside kart

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ขับได้ดีมาก

scenes.imageDescription: Same parked kart behind them; brothers standing together, identities unchanged.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium two-shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both face return portal; kart remains parked behind in final state.

scenes.title: กลับจากสนามแข่ง
scenes.continuityStartState: Both side-by-side facing return portal; kart parked behind.

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ด่านนี้สนุกมาก

scenes.imageDescription: Canonical brothers enter one portal; same kart remains parked behind, no reset.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into portal. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Portal closes after both pass; race state remains complete.
